title: 1x8 Splitter Tree with Grating Coupler Outputs
summary: Implement a 1x8 optical power splitter tree built from cascaded 1x2 MMI splitters. Route each of the eight outputs to an individual grating coupler for off-chip coupling.

blocks.notes: Cascaded in a binary tree to produce 8 outputs from 1 input (3 stages: 1->2, 2->4, 4->8). Target ~50/50 split per MMI; include tapers/transitions per PDK requirements.
One grating coupler per splitter output. Use consistent polarization/orientation; arrange in a fiber-array-compatible pitch if required by packaging.

wiring_notes: Topology: Stage 1: 1x2 MMI takes the single input. Stage 2: two 1x2 MMIs split the two branches to four. Stage 3: four 1x2 MMIs split to eight outputs.
Route waveguides from each final-stage MMI output to a dedicated grating coupler, keeping path lengths matched if uniform phase is desired.
Maintain minimum bend radius, waveguide spacing, and crossing avoidance per process rules; use gentle S-bends/fanout to reach grating couplers.
If using a fiber array, place the 8 grating couplers in a straight line at standard pitch; ensure all couplers have the same coupling direction (or specify alternating if needed).

objective.target_behavior: 1 optical input split into 8 approximately equal-power outputs, each terminated by a grating coupler for off-chip coupling.
